source_text: Sed ad propositum revertamur. Oportet Levitas operari et onera portare. Columnae et atria portantur a Levitis, non ab Israelitis communibus — angeli quosdam rapiunt leves a delictis, alios adhuc praegravatos portant. Concedat Dominus ut a talibus operariis portati liberemur a sagitta volante in tenebris et a daemonio meridiano, donec veniamus ad locum repromissionis per Christum Dominum nostrum, cui honor et imperium in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: But to proposition let-us-return. It-behooves Levites to-work and burdens to-carry. Columns and courts are-carried by Levites, not by Israelites common — angels some snatch light from faults, others still weighed-down carry. May-grant Lord that by such workers carried we-may-be-freed from arrow flying in darkness and from demon noonday, until we-come to place of-promise through Christ Lord our, to-whom honor and dominion unto ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: But let us return to the point. The Levites must work and bear the loads. Pillars and courts are borne by Levites, not by common Israelites — and angels [[snatch up some who are light, purged of faults >> Bible:1 Thessalonians 4:17]], while they still carry others weighed by remnants of sin. May the Lord grant that, borne by such workers, we be freed from the [[arrow that flies in darkness >> Bible:Psalm 91:5-6]] and the noonday demon, until we reach the place of promise through Christ our Lord, to whom be honor and dominion forever. Amen.
